name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.CheckOutCharges
comment:
Furniture charges at check-out. The student answers only for what got worse while they lived there:
  • a personal item (of their Bed): its condition at check-out, or the worst an inspection recorded during the stay, against its condition in their final check-in inventory (without one: Good). Charge = the price of one new item of its type × (share lost in the condition now − share lost in the condition at check-in), never below 0. An item recorded as there before the student is never charged;
  • a shared item: only damage the student acknowledged ({@code asg_damage_claim}); otherwise the dorm bears it.
Prices and shares come from Admin › Furniture types (INV's {@code furniturePrices}, {@code conditionLoss}). No dispute window: the student agrees at the desk.

methods.name: percent
methods.comment: The percent of the price a condition costs (Admin › Furniture types › condition levels).

methods.name: lines
methods.signature: lines(long, long, long, long, java.time.Instant, java.util.Map)
methods.comment: The lines of the student's check-out.

methods.name: claimAmount
methods.comment: The amount a shared item costs in its condition (for a damage claim).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.CheckOutCharges$Line
comment: A line of the check-out.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.CheckOutFurnitureService
comment: The furniture part of a check-out, with the student at the desk. Staff record the condition of each item the student answers for (their Bed's items and the Room's shared items); the charges follow {@link CheckOutCharges} and the student reads them on the app and agrees before Staff complete the check-out. An item the student does not accept goes to a Manager, who keeps or drops it the same day; until then it is not charged. Shared items are charged only for damage the student acknowledged ({@link #claim}). There is no dispute window afterwards.

methods.name: record
methods.comment: Records the furniture of the check-out (a draft until the desk completes it) and, with the student present, asks them to agree on the app. Any change asks for a new agreement.

methods.name: claim
methods.comment: Damage to a shared item that Staff attribute to a resident of the Room: charged at check-out only once the student acknowledges it within {@code handover.acknowledge_hours}.

methods.name: decide
methods.comment: A Manager keeps or drops an item the student did not accept. Kept after the check-out was completed, it is invoiced to the student (DAMAGE); dropped, nobody pays.

methods.name: mine
methods.comment: The student's own check-out charges (null when Staff recorded none yet) and shared damage to acknowledge.

methods.name: answerClaim
methods.comment: The student confirms (or declines) damage to a shared item Staff attributed to them.

methods.name: expireClaims
methods.comment: Claims not answered by their deadline are not charged.

methods.name: checkOutRow
methods.comment: The check-out record of the Allocation, created as a draft when Staff start with the furniture.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.CheckOutFurnitureService$Answer
comment: Staff's answer for an item; {@code amount} overrides the computed charge (with a reason).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.CheckOutFurnitureService$Line
comment: A line as screens show it; {@code review}: Pending, Kept or Dropped when a Manager was asked.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.CheckOutFurnitureService$SettlementPreview
comment: Settlement preview shown to the student when checking and confirming the check-out package.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService
comment: The Check-in and Check-out desk. Since phase 5 the desk check-in only records the hand-over (D-19): residence comes with the door code ({@link DoorCodeRelease}); a student whose Room has no code yet becomes a resident here. Check-in needs the Balance (with its Utility Deposit) paid and today inside the Term's check-in window or an approved late check-in. Check-out (every resident, with or without the desk check-in) records the final meter reading and the Room's condition; Billing settles the Utility Deposit and the refund goes to its approver; a terminated stay closes its termination. Allocations are addressed by id, never by student code (B-01).

methods.name: inventoryCheck
methods.comment: A new resident (Admin › System parameters › Room handover on) checks in by their check-in inventory: the desk waits until it is final, so they never become a resident whose Room condition and meters are not recorded. Empty when no inventory is needed (the setting is off, or they stay in the same Room).

methods.name: activeOf
methods.comment: The student's active Allocation in the Term; without a Term, the latest one not checked in yet.

methods.name: byName
methods.comment: By name among the Term's Allocations in scope; several matches ask for the student code.

methods.name: roomReadings
methods.comment: The Rooms whose leavers have not checked out yet, with the reading already saved on their drafts: the desk enters the final meter readings Room by Room (or from a file) before the students come, and each check-out then opens with it (spec §6.16).

methods.name: roomReadingsTemplate
methods.comment: The template to fill in Excel: one line per Room with leavers waiting, the readings saved so far filled in.

methods.name: saveRoomReadingsFile
methods.comment: Reads the template back (CSV or XLSX; headers room/phòng, electricity/điện, water/nước).

methods.name: saveRoomReadings
methods.comment: Saves each Room's final reading on the check-out drafts of all its leavers (their condition, key and damages stay as they are). A Room without leavers or a reading below the Room's last one is reported, not saved.

methods.name: waitingByRoom
methods.comment: Leavers not checked out yet, by Room code (continuing residents stay unless their check-out started).

methods.name: damages
methods.comment: The damages sent, by furniture item of the Room; an item may be listed once.

methods.name: saveDamages
methods.comment: Replaces the check-out's damage lines; null leaves them as they are (an older client).

methods.name: checkOutBy
methods.comment: The day leavers of the Term must have checked out: N's date in the next Term's renewal, else the day after the stay.

methods.name: checkOutTarget
methods.comment: A resident's or a checked-out Allocation in the user's scope.

methods.name: checkOutRows
methods.comment: Residents' Allocations and the ones ended by check-out, with their check-out record.

methods.name: beds
methods.comment: The Beds of the Allocations, each with its Room's class in the Allocation's Term.

methods.name: active
methods.comment: Active Allocations of the Term with Beds in scope.

methods.name: fold
methods.comment: Lower case without Vietnamese diacritics, so "nguyen van" finds "Nguyễn Văn".

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$Check
comment: {@code hint}: what to do while the check is not passed (null when nothing to add).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$Damage
comment: Damage to one furniture item of the Room; {@code amount} VND.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$DamageItem
comment: A furniture item of the Room with the damage recorded for it (0 when none).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$FurnitureRecord
comment: The furniture recorded by condition for the check-out: whether any, the charge (lines a Manager reviews or dropped left out), whether the student is present and agreed, and the items that got worse.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$Person
comment: {@code status}: ready, blocked, checked-in or not-allocated.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$Placed
comment: An Allocation with its Bed and, for check-out, its check-out record.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$PreviousReading
comment: The Room's latest reading and date before check-out, shown to Staff as a reference note.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$Recent
comment: A student of the desk's side lists; {@code studentCode} opens them at the desk.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$RoomReading
comment: A Room with leavers waiting: the reading saved on their drafts (null when none yet) and its previous reading.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.DeskService$Today
comment: {@code expected} = every Allocation of the Term in the Blocks (not only today's arrivals). {@code window} is {@code UPCOMING} before {@code checkInStart}, {@code OPEN} through {@code checkInEnd}, then {@code CLOSED} (late check-ins are still recorded); null when the Term has no check-in days.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.inventory.FurnitureService
comment: Furniture items (ADR-24, spec D-21, §6.19): every piece with its asset code, status and location (a Room or the store of a Block), and its history. Staff and Managers change the status and move items inside their Blocks, now or as a planned move (a task); Managers register new items and move them between Blocks.

methods.name: stock
methods.comment: The stock of every furniture type per Block (Staff: their Blocks; Managers: every Block), with what the store is worth at the types' real prices. Disposed items are left out.

methods.name: register
methods.comment: Registers new items of a type in a Room or in the store of a Block (Managers: the catalogue).

methods.name: update
methods.comment: Changes an item's status or note; In store needs a store, In use a Room; Disposed is final.

methods.name: move
methods.comment: Moves items to a Room or to the store of a Block, now or as a planned move. Inside the user's Blocks: Staff and Managers; to another Block: Managers only.

methods.name: finishMove
methods.comment: The planned move happened: the item is now at its new place. Staff of either Block may record it.

methods.name: ofRoom
methods.comment: Items in the Room (not disposed), for the Room hub.

methods.name: mine
methods.comment: The furniture of the Room where the student holds a Bed now, with any stay-time damage/missing reports.

methods.name: report
methods.comment: Student declares or updates a furniture item's worn/damaged/missing state during their stay (or clears with Good).

methods.name: apply
methods.comment: Puts the item at its new place; In store items in a Room are In use, items in use in a store are In store.

methods.name: target
methods.comment: A Room (by code) or the store of a Block (by code).

methods.name: lock
methods.comment: Items locked in id order, with where they are; an unknown id is 404.

methods.name: on
methods.comment: A Maintenance Request names the item: its history keeps the repair (spec §6.18).

methods.name: on
methods.comment: Damage recorded at a check-out: the item is Broken until it is repaired (spec §6.16).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.inventory.FurnitureService$HistoryEntry
comment: {@code kind}: Registered, Status changed or Moved; {@code from} / {@code to} are statuses or locations.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.inventory.FurnitureService$Location
comment: {@code kind}: Room or Store; {@code room} null in a store.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.inventory.FurnitureService$Place
comment: Where an item is: in a Room or in the store of a Block.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.inventory.FurnitureService$RoomItem
comment: A student's view of an item of their Room.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.inventory.FurnitureService$StockRow
comment: One furniture type in one Block: items in the Block's store, in its Rooms, broken or in repair (wherever they are) and waiting in a planned move; {@code unitPrice} is the real price of Admin › Furniture types (null: not set) and {@code storeValue} the store's items at that price.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.inventory.FurnitureService$StockTotals
comment: Totals over the rows; {@code unpriced}: types that have items but no real price yet.
